[LCON.3.6] **The two categories differ in provenance, not in
pass criterion.** A cross-platform run compares against a
reference captured under a different platform signature; it
compares it the same way, byte for byte. No scenario may be
excluded from strict conformance on the grounds that its
result is platform-dependent — under [LDET.3.4.1] no v1
result is.
